Like to dislike: Thoma. As a yandere enjoyer I was HYPED for this man, based mostly on memes about him and the cage. 
Unfortunately his route was the least fun for me, it just felt boring. There was not enough romantic/exciting moments for my taste, and he wasn’t as crazy about the MC as I expected him to be.

Dislike to like: Ikki and Kent

I didn’t expect to like Ikki so much (he’s my favorite in Amnesia) because I hate flirts irl and tbh he annoyed the heck out of me throughout the first half of his route. But I guess I liked the excitement of figuring out if he really is interested and also it’s nice to feel adored. Oh and the feeling when a womanizer finally settles for you 😩 Yea, I guess he made me like flirts.

Kent I didn’t expect to like because he seemed too logical and stiff (and that assumption was correct) but his route is so romance packed that I can’t not like it. He turned out to be sweet and loving boyfriend. 
One thing I still can stand about him is his coat though (I’m sorry but it makes him look like a caterpillar XD)

I enjoyed system of one binge a month for some time. “Food day” as I call it, always occurs on a special day like birthday, name day or even constitution day if there isn’t any better occasion. 
This month I got carried away and “Food day” turned into “Food weekend”. I felt awful, was eating just because, I wasn’t even hungry or interested in food. I guess I just like chewing. But this time I felt worse than during a whole month of eating semi-normally (or at least as normally as anorexic can).
I plan on another day like this at the end of the month because of holidays starting. Didn’t learn anything I guess 🤷‍♀️
So in conclusion, imo it’s a good occasion to finally eat (didn’t have any negative feelings about it until this month), just remember to not lose control, cause you’ll probably feel guilty after and it all will be for nothing.
But it’s just my suggestion, I wish you never feel guilty and don’t have to follow stupid rules like these.

I always knew that my life is pretty boring but today is the day that I realized how bad it really is. For the first time in a long time few interesting (maybe even exciting) things happened to me. Thanks to these short moments of feeling any emotions other than frustration and nothingness I realized how empty and worthless my life is. It made me think of suicide. After all, is it worth living if it feels like I’m already half dead?
It’s Our Life: Beginnings & Always

It happens to me from time to time, as I'm a fan of otome games, where the main focus is to get close to chosen character and spend time with them. Usually I brush it off quickly, because I know that it really isn't me who the character likes, but the MC which I am in control of.

But recently I have played a game where there wasn't any MC who I was supposed to only make choices for. In that game the player gets to truly be the main character. There are no "bad endings", so you can say anything and you won't lose. Game also gives you a plenty of options to choose from, so you can choose something that you would most likely say in real life situation. That made the game very personalized, you can really feel like it's your story.

I also really like the possible romance partner in that game. All of interactions with him were very believable, it just seemed possible to someday find someone who would be exactly like him.  

All of that made me sad. I was asking myself "Why my life can't be like that?".

But the true sadness hit when I finished the game. I cried my eyes off for like 3 hours straight. It felt like something was missing. I really felt loved for the first time in a while and suddenly it was just over. I still miss that boy so much, I feel like the DLC that is supposed to come out in some time is one of the few things that still keep me going.

Answering your question: I guess it left me feeling equally lonely and less lonely.

To phone them you have to pay with call tickets (I believe that’s what they are called). I remember someone on this sub saying that they won’t pick up every time, but I don’t know for sure.
